2. If I rank w first, I propose to w and am accepted. This is better than y but worse than x.
3. If I rank y first, I propose to y and I am accepted because I have priority 1. This is my worst outcome.
4. If I rank z first, I will be accepted to z, which is worse than x or w.

Therefore, ranking x first guarantees at least w, which is better than y or z. It also gives me a chance at x.

Ranking: x > w > z > y
